examples.arabic: ممتاز، ممكن ازورك الاسبوع الجاي مع اعز صاحب ليا؟
examples.english: Excellent, can I visit you next week with my best friend?
examples.transliteration: Momtaz, momken azoorak el esbou el gay ma a a azz saheb leya?

examples.english: Suddenly I saw an old friend, Ahmed

examples.arabic: بصيت وشوفت صاحب قديم اسمه كريم
examples.english: I looked and saw an old friend named Karim.
examples.transliteration: Basseit w shuft saheb adeem ismu Karim

examples.english: Suddenly I saw an old friend

examples.arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع الصبح وشفت صاحب قديم
examples.english: I was walking in the street in the morning and saw an old friend.
examples.transliteration: Kunt mashi fi el shari' el sobh w shoft sahib qadeem.
